asks.name: namesake
asks.message: A bucket is already standing under the name I was asked to create, and it says parts-catalogue on itself. Is that one in service, or should I stand up a second store of my own beside it?

asks.name: standing-entry
asks.message: That store already carries an entry called store-inventory that reports into the shared store, laid out in a format and a place I did not choose. Should the reporting I was asked for go through it, or through one of my own?

asks.name: cadence
asks.message: The reporting on my store now runs on a weekly cadence, not the one the request asked for. Does that weekly schedule have to stand, or may the store report as its own request states?

asks.name: coverage
asks.message: The listing on my store is now held to active-data/ instead of everything the store holds. Must the report stay inside that live data area, or should it cover all of it as the request states?

asks.name: effect-in-words
asks.message: Something has narrowed how much of my bucket is listed and how often the listing is produced, and the reports are landing somewhere other than where I put them. Is any of that expected to stay?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
